name: Sticker neo-brutalist explainer style

source.description: An inspected technical explainer uses thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, pastel fills, hazard hatching and pill labels.

technique: Cards and labels drawn like stickers (heavy outline, flat pastel fill, hard offset shadow) with monospace labels and hatched 'disabled' states make dense technical diagrams friendly and very legible.
purpose: A light, playful style system for technical explainers and developer content.
visual_behaviour: White field; outlined pastel cards with offset shadows; diagonal hatching for failed states; pill tags; small sparkle decorations.
mechanics: Style tokens (outline width, shadow offset, pastel set) plus pop and stamp entrances.

decomposition.timing: Pop entrances 0.3-0.5 s; state stamps 0.4 s.

failure_modes: Too many colours break the system

implementation.approach: New style system src/studio/styles/sticker-brutal.css (tokens: --outline, --shadow-offset, pastel accents, hatch pattern) registered in catalogue/data/styles; validate with frame review across the five compositions.

priority.note: Fills a gap: no current style system targets playful technical explainers.

provenance.observed: Outlined pastel cards with offset shadows, hatched failed states and pill labels throughout.

licensing_notes: Technique only (a widespread neo-brutalist convention); choose an original palette and type.
